name: @help-wanted/shared
description: Protocol facts for HELP WANTED: addresses, the house feeds, canonical JSON, the order header, work records, the oracle question hash, a typed IdentityMD API client and ABIs (ours from the launch projects' build output). Exports its TypeScript sources: import it from a bundler, vitest or tsx (plain `node` cannot resolve them); `pnpm build` emits JavaScript to dist/ for anything else.

scripts.gen: pnpm run abi:gen && pnpm run feeds:gen
